armorNotes.value: chain shirt over a traveler's coat

equipmentTemplates.value: A weapon suited to their training, a bedroll, rations for a week, and a keepsake they won't explain.
Well-worn traveling gear, a small coin purse, and a journal with more crossed-out entries than finished ones.
A weapon, a healer's kit half-used, and a letter they haven't opened yet.

backgroundTemplates: {name} left home before anyone could talk them out of it.
{name} used to have a much quieter life, before circumstances intervened.
{name} trained for this longer than most people would guess, and still feels unready.
{name} fell into this line of work by accident and never quite fell back out.
backstoryTemplates: {name} took up the {className}'s path after losing something they still haven't replaced. The road since has been more about momentum than direction.
Nobody in {name}'s hometown expected them to become a {className} -- least of all {name}. It stuck anyway.
{name} trained under someone who's no longer around to see how it turned out. Being a {className} is, in part, still an argument with that absence.

ideals.value: "Debts get paid, one way or another."
"The job comes first -- feelings can wait."

bonds.value: A family back home that doesn't know what's become of them.
A mentor whose approval still matters more than it should.
A promise made to someone who didn't survive to see it kept.
A hometown they swore they'd come back and fix.

flaws.value: Trusts too easily, and has the scars to prove it.
Can't let a slight go unanswered, even a small one.
Underestimates how much their own reputation precedes them.
Would rather act first and explain later, often to their own cost.

designNotes.value: Procedurally rolled -- attributes/background are template-generated, HP/proficiency/spell slots are computed from the real linked Class.
